title: K$_{2}$BaPO$_{4}$F
comments:
This is a form of \href{current_web_home_dir/A5BC3_tI36_140_cl_b_ah-001}{Cs$_{3}$CoCl$_{5}$ (K3$_{1}$)} and \href{current_web_home_dir/AB2C5D_tI36_140_a_h_cl_b-001}{BaLa$_{2}$ZnO$_{5}$} where the (4a) and (16h) sites contain different species. 
 To prevent the proliferation of prototypes we assign both K$_{2}$BaPO$_{4}$F and Sr$_{3}$AlO$_{4}$F structures to this prototype. 
 The ICSD assigns all of these to the Cs$_{3}$CoCl$_{5}$ structure type.
